VALUE Expected completion in 2026 N/A DISCIPLINES N/A Project Overview This project provides consultancy and project management services for Al-Muqeem Municipality in Madinah. BECT oversees planning, execution and handover, including tender documents, schedules, cost estimates and risk plans. The team monitors contractor performance, quality and safety, reviews technical submissions, manages meetings and documentation, and supervises snag-list closure and final handover procedures.
